summary: Toyota Motor Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing a September 3, 2026 press release on its August share repurchase activity. The company bought back 28,211,700 common shares for JPY 86,494,175,900 (approx. $580M) in open-market purchases from August 5–31, 2026, under a board-authorized program of up to 500 million shares and JPY 1 trillion through August 4, 2027. Authorization was granted under Japan's Companies Act. No price per share or premium stated. This routine periodic disclosure updates ongoing buyback progress. What to watch: continued execution pace toward the large repurchase ceiling.
